web_content_ba24ca13c55ce294.primary_content:
Semantic Internal Linking

Semantic internal linking connects pages based on meaning, not only exact keyword matches.
A page about topic clusters may be related to internal link authority even if the exact phrase is different.

A crawled article viewer must display the stored article body exactly as it was preserved.
This allows users to inspect what the crawler actually captured from the website.
